text:
Nora W.: hi all — i've been having sensory overload in the open area near team C. bright lights + desk chatter make it hard to focus and my tinnitus flares. can i request a quieter desk near the window or permission to use a noise-blocking partition?
Sam T.: oh no, sorry to hear that nora. the window desks are on my onboarding schedule for the rest of the quarter — i asked for that spot because of my back issues and standing desk setup.
Nora W.: totally understand, sam. i'm raising this as a temporary accommodation request, not trying to kick you out. hoping we can find a swap or rotation.
Alex (manager): thanks for flagging. Nora, please submit an accommodation intake so HR has docs. Sam, can you share your note about the back issues? we need to balance both needs.
Riley (people-ops): options: short-term quiet desk swap, alternating morning/evening windows, noise-cancelling headphones + partition, or a private focus room booking schedule. please fill the intake form: https://internal.company/hr/accom-form — we keep medical details to HR only.
Sam T.: i can share a doctor's note. i'm still in my probation period and worried about workspace changes affecting my onboarding.
Alex (manager): Sam, probation won't be used to deny reasonable accommodations. we'll document adjustments. main goal: keep both of you productive.
Nora W.: i'd be fine with alternating the window desk M/W and Sam T. using it T/Th, if that's workable.
Sam T.: alternating could work if i can still do my standing setup some days. thanks for proposing that.
Riley (people-ops): we'll set up a short intake call to capture dates and restrictions. timeline: temporary arrangement for 6 weeks while we evaluate. People Ops will create a private memo for you and Alex only.
people-ops-bot: Accommodation intake opened by Nora W.  intake-id 20260415-3321. People Ops to follow up within 48h. (automated)
Legal: quick note: document only work adjustments and dates in the team docs. medical records stay in HR. no retaliation clause applies.
Alex (manager): action: i'll update seating plan and add an alternating schedule; i'll also flag onboarding tasks that need the window desk and reassign if necessary.
Nora W.: appreciate it. i can use a monitor arm and dictation for short bursts too.
Sam T.: thanks everyone. i'll upload my note and be flexible for the first 6 weeks.
Riley (people-ops): perfect — we'll confirm the schedule after intake call. 1-week check-in planned. thanks all.
